name: web_search

query.description: Natural-language search query. Be specific — include domain, timeframe, or entity names to improve result relevance.

description: Search the web for current information. ALWAYS use for: real-time data (prices, weather, scores), recent events or news, verifying facts that may have changed (leadership, releases, dates), or any query where accuracy depends on recency. Use even if memory contains related information — memory may be outdated. When in doubt, search.
